name: Kettlebell Dead Cluster
description: A 'cluster' is a clean → front squat → press strung into one continuous rep; 'dead' means the bell starts and returns dead on the floor each rep — no bounce, no momentum carried between reps. Dead clean the bell from the floor to the rack, sink into a front squat, drive out of the bottom and let that leg drive feed a press to overhead, then lower back to the rack and set the bell down dead. Full-body power in a single string: legs clean it, legs squat it, legs drive the press. Loosely called a 'dead cluster' in the flow it comes from.
